review_contract.visual_qa_basis: Per-asset visual QA notes in asset_manifest.json; environment plates also use environment_visual_review.json. This ledger binds those records to the current files and does not replace pixel-level inspection.
checklist: Capture the current SHA-256 for each manifest raster and each cited art_import/ source.
Capture the current SHA-256 for each paired dark-plum and warm-cream QA preview.
Keep per-asset visual QA notes and the Section 27 environment signoff as the pixel-review record.
Require fresh pixel-level inspection against art_import/ before accepting any changed raster or preview.
